definitions.explanation: A large bird with a bare head that feeds on carrion. In everyday speech the name covers vultures in general.
Figuratively, an investor or fund that buys up failing companies cheaply in order to sell them off at a profit.

examples.japanese: ハゲタカ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}っている→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: Vultures are circling in the sky.

examples.japanese: ハゲタカ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{死|し}んだ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦サバンナ→サバンナ：28719_sabanna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ハゲタカ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ライオン→ライオン：05197_raion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧くる。
examples.english: On the savanna, vultures gather to go after what the lions leave.

examples.japanese: ハゲタカファンド⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買収|ばいしゅう}→買収：04780_baishuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was bought by a vulture fund.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外資系|がいしけい}→外資系：12219_gaishikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ハゲタカ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{狙|ねら}われる→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: To be targeted by foreign predatory investors.

examples.japanese: {経営難|けいえいなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}い{叩|たた}く→買い叩く：19261_kaitataku⟧ハゲタカ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The vulture-like practice of buying struggling companies at rock-bottom prices was criticized.

notes:
Literally a 'bald hawk' ({禿|は}げ + ⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧). Sense 2 spread in the late 1990s and 2000s, when foreign funds bought failing Japanese banks and firms; it is strongly negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハゲタカファンド: vulture fund
- ハゲタカ{外資|がいし}: predatory foreign capital
- ハゲタカ⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧: like a vulture (preying on the weak)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハゲワシ: vulture — the more precise zoological name for Old World vultures
